purpose: Re-evaluate the corrected ECF-shape detector with series-level sequential false-alarm calibration that respects overlapping rolling windows and the full monitoring horizon.

relationship_to_v1.v1_failure: The v1 threshold grid did not attain the target series-level false-alarm rate; CFAD Gaussian-null false alarms were 0.885 at the maximum tested h=12.
relationship_to_v1.preservation_rule: v1 remains a separate failed experiment and is not reinterpreted as successful after v2.
relationship_to_v1.parameter_rule: Detector and scenario parameters are retained from v1; only the sequential calibration/evaluation contract changes.

scenarios.null_gaussian: Stationary N(0, sigma^2). Primary threshold-calibration law and primary null evaluation.
scenarios.null_student_t: Stationary Student-t(df=5), rescaled to sigma. External null validation for stable non-Gaussian shape.
scenarios.shape_student_t: Gaussian before the change; Student-t(df=4), rescaled to the same standard deviation, after the change.
scenarios.shape_skew: Gaussian before the change; standardized skew-normal(shape=8) after the change, preserving post-segment sample mean 0 and sample standard deviation sigma.
scenarios.mean_shift: Gaussian throughout with post-change mean +1.5 sigma and unchanged variance.
scenarios.variance_shift: Gaussian throughout with post-change standard deviation 1.75 sigma and unchanged mean.

monte_carlo.seed_rule: All v2 calibration and evaluation seeds are disjoint from v1 and from one another.

sequential_calibration.primary_estimand: P(at least one alarm during the monitored post-calibration horizon under the stationary Gaussian null)
sequential_calibration.calibration_statistic: For each null replicate and method, standardize the rolling statistic using only its initial calibration block; then start a fresh two-sided Page-CUSUM at zero after that block and record the maximum of max(S_plus, S_minus) over the complete remaining monitoring horizon without alarm resets.
sequential_calibration.threshold_rule: Set the method-specific decision threshold h to the empirical 0.95 quantile of the replicate-level maximum path statistic using NumPy quantile method='higher'.
sequential_calibration.attainment_gate: Before alternative-scenario evaluation, independently verify on fresh Gaussian-null evaluation seeds that the Wilson 95% confidence interval for series-level false alarms contains 0.05 and that the point estimate is <= 0.10. If this gate fails, alternative-scenario results are still saved for transparency but the publication screen automatically fails.
sequential_calibration.state_rule: The calibration score block estimates mu0 and sigma0 only. It does not update the CUSUM state. Monitoring begins immediately after the calibration score block with S_plus=S_minus=0.
sequential_calibration.overlap_rule: Primary calibration retains window=60 and step=5, so the null simulation includes the same strong overlap dependence as the detector evaluation.
sequential_calibration.distribution_rule: Thresholds are calibrated only on the prospectively specified Gaussian null. Student-t(df=5) is a separate robustness null and is not used to tune h.

evaluation.null_metric: Series-level probability of at least one alarm during the monitored post-calibration horizon.
evaluation.first_alarm_rule: For changed-series scenarios, classify the first alarm after calibration. A first alarm before the known change is a false-alarm replicate and cannot later count as a successful detection.
evaluation.pre_change_metric: Probability that the first post-calibration alarm occurs before the known change point.
evaluation.power_metric: Probability that the first post-calibration alarm occurs from the change point through change_point + post_change_horizon inclusive.
evaluation.delay_metric: Observation delay of that first alarm from the change point, conditional on successful detection.
evaluation.intervals: Wilson 95% confidence intervals for rates; median and interquartile range for conditional delay.

diagnostics.non_overlapping_sensitivity: Repeat null calibration/evaluation with step=60 as a diagnostic only; it cannot replace or tune the primary overlapping-window result.
diagnostics.threshold_reporting: Save the full distribution of replicate maximum path statistics, selected method thresholds, independent calibration-check rates, and whether each threshold is finite and positive.

publication_screen.note: Prospectively fixed v2 criteria. Passing requires false-alarm control first; power cannot compensate for a failed null-control gate.
